screen.bettergamerules.title: Game Rules
message.bettergamerules.no_permission: You don't have permission to modify game rules!
message.bettergamerules.gamerule_changed: Game rule %s has been set to %s
gamerule.bettergamerules.doFireTick.desc: Controls whether fire spreads and destroys blocks
gamerule.bettergamerules.keepInventory.d: Whether players keep their inventory and experience after death
gamerule.bettergamerules.randomTickSpeed: Number of random block updates per chunk per tick. Default 3, higher=faster crop growth, 0=disabled
gamerule.bettergamerules.doDaylightCycle: Whether the day-night cycle advances. Time freezes when disabled
gamerule.bettergamerules.doMobSpawning.d: Whether mobs (monsters and animals) spawn naturally
Whether weather transitions between clear, rain, and thunderstorm automatically
gamerule.bettergamerules.mobGriefing.des: Whether creepers, endermen, withers, ghasts, sheep, etc. can change or destroy blocks
gamerule.bettergamerules.commandBlockOut: Whether command blocks notify admins in chat when executing commands
gamerule.bettergamerules.doInsomnia.desc: Whether phantoms spawn for players who haven't slept for 3+ days
gamerule.bettergamerules.disableRaids.de: Whether village raids are disabled. Bad Omen won't trigger raids when enabled
gamerule.bettergamerules.playersSleeping: Percentage of online players needed to sleep to skip the night. Default 100, set to 0 for 1 player
gamerule.bettergamerules.doTraderSpawnin: Whether wandering traders spawn, including their potion and invisibility effects
gamerule.bettergamerules.announceAdvance: Whether advancements are announced in chat for all players
gamerule.bettergamerules.doImmediateResp: Whether players respawn immediately without showing the death screen
gamerule.bettergamerules.doLimitedCrafti: Whether players can only craft recipes they have unlocked
gamerule.bettergamerules.doVinesSpread.d: Whether vines, glow berries, weeping vines, and twisting vines grow and spread naturally
gamerule.bettergamerules.doWardenSpawnin: Whether sculk shriekers can summon wardens
gamerule.bettergamerules.forgiveDeadPlay: Whether angered neutral mobs become neutral again after their target dies
gamerule.bettergamerules.logAdminCommand: Whether admin commands are logged in the server log
gamerule.bettergamerules.maxCommandChain: Maximum depth of chained command block execution. Default 65536
gamerule.bettergamerules.maxEntityCrammi: Max entities that can occupy a single block before taking 3 suffocation damage per half-second. Default 24
gamerule.bettergamerules.reducedDebugInf: Whether the F3 debug screen is simplified. Some info hidden from non-admins when enabled
gamerule.bettergamerules.sendCommandFeed: Whether command execution feedback appears in chat
gamerule.bettergamerules.showDeathMessag: Whether player death messages appear in chat
gamerule.bettergamerules.spawnRadius.des: Radius of the spawn protection area. Default 10, set to 0 to disable
Whether angered neutral mobs attack all nearby players, not just the one that angered them
gamerule.bettergamerules.doPatrolSpawnin: Whether pillager patrols spawn. Disabled prevents natural patrol generation
gamerule.bettergamerules.doEntityDrops.d: Whether non-mob entities (minecarts, boats, item frames, etc.) drop items when destroyed
gamerule.bettergamerules.blockExplosionD: Whether blocks destroyed by non-entity explosions (TNT, beds) have some drops removed
gamerule.bettergamerules.mobExplosionDro: Whether blocks destroyed by mob explosions (creepers, ghast fireballs) have some drops removed
gamerule.bettergamerules.tntExplosionDro: Whether blocks destroyed by TNT explosions have some drops removed
gamerule.bettergamerules.snowAccumulatio: Max number of snow layers that accumulate per block during snowfall. Default 1, 0 prevents snow buildup
gamerule.bettergamerules.waterSourceConv: Whether flowing water creates new water sources when touching 2+ source blocks (infinite water)
gamerule.bettergamerules.lavaSourceConve: Whether flowing lava can form infinite lava sources (in the Nether)
gamerule.bettergamerules.globalSoundEven: Whether all players hear global sound events (e.g. wither, ender dragon, elder guardian)
gamerule.bettergamerules.commandModifica: Max blocks that /fill, /clone, etc. can modify in a single operation. Default 32768
gamerule.bettergamerules.maxCommandForkC: Maximum number of branches created by /execute and similar in a single command. Default 65536
gamerule.bettergamerules.disableElytraMo: Whether to disable server-side anti-cheat movement checks for elytra flight
gamerule.bettergamerules.spawnChunkRadiu: Radius of chunks around the world spawn that stay loaded at all times
gamerule.bettergamerules.enderPearlsVani: Whether thrown ender pearls vanish when the player dies before the pearl lands
gamerule.bettergamerules.fireDamage.desc: Whether players take fire damage (excluding lava)
gamerule.bettergamerules.freezeDamage.de: Whether players take freeze damage from powder snow
gamerule.bettergamerules.naturalRegenera: Whether players naturally regenerate health when hunger is full. Disable for golden apple / potion-only healing
gamerule.bettergamerules.doTileDrops.des: Whether blocks drop items when broken. Nothing drops when disabled
gamerule.bettergamerules.projectilesCanB: Whether projectiles (wither skulls, ghast fireballs, etc.) can destroy blocks
gamerule.bettergamerules.mobExplosionBlo: Whether mob explosions (creepers, etc.) can destroy blocks (separate from drop decay)
gamerule.bettergamerules.tntExplosionBlo: Whether TNT explosions can destroy blocks (separate from drop decay)
gamerule.bettergamerules.playersNetherPo: Ticks non-creative players must stand in a nether portal before teleporting. Default 80 (4 seconds)
Ticks creative players must stand in a nether portal before teleporting. Default 1 (instant)
